archetypes.name: checkpoint-hardening
archetypes.rationale: Runtime checkpoint changes alter failure routing across Step 5, Step 7a, CI, and OOS filing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed failure-routing paths for stale state, preserved exit codes, and sentinel semantics. Pay special attention to whether best-effort flushes remain best-effort only where the run is already terminal, and whether hard-stop paths surface stable reasons without changing public KV contracts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-parity
archetypes.rationale: The change syncs Python behavior with shell and markdown harness contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the Step 7a and Step 18 documentation, shell harnesses, and Python tests describe the same stdout keys, exit-code preservation, and default behavior. Look for stale literals, retired statuses, or assertions that no longer match the Python implementation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
